title: caddyhttp: demote Alt-Svc ErrNoAltSvcPort to debug level
body:
When HTTP/3 is enabled, ServeListener runs in a background goroutine.  If early HTTP/1 or HTTP/2 requests arrive before that goroutine registers the listener with quic-go, SetQUICHeaders returns http3.ErrNoAltSvcPort.

Because Alt-Svc is an opportunistic advertisement header and this startup window is transient, log
ErrNoAltSvcPort at debug level instead of error level to avoid spurious error logs during startup and reloads.




## Assistance Disclosure

I used Gemini to find the source of the problem and devise a fix. I verified the code and tested it in production.
